figures.caption: Fig. 1 Schematic representation of the screening funnel. Structures down- loaded from experimental repositories go sequentially through several computational filters. Each stage of the screening discards structures that are unsuitable as solid-state electrolytes based on ever more complex calculated properties. The final outcome is of a few tens of viable structures, that could be potential candidates for novel solid-state Li-ion conductors.
